scenes.situation: You meet someone for the first time.
Someone asks your name at a gathering.

lines.speaker: learner
lines.text: My name is Anna. Your name?

scenes.situation: You run into a neighbour in the morning.

lines.speaker: learner
lines.text: I am well. Thanks. And you?

scenes.situation: You are leaving a friend's house.

lines.speaker: learner
lines.text: Thank you. We will meet again.

scenes.situation: Someone helps you carry something heavy.
You accidentally step on someone's foot.
You want to know the price of vegetables at a market.

lines.speaker: learner
lines.text: What is the price of this?

scenes.situation: The price is higher than you expected.

lines.speaker: learner
lines.text: It's very expensive. Can you reduce it a little?

lines.speaker: other
lines.text: OK, one hundred and seventy rupees.

scenes.situation: You are looking for a specific item.

lines.speaker: other
lines.text: Yes, look here, very good ones.

scenes.situation: You want to pay and finish the transaction.
A vendor is trying to sell you something you don't want.
You want to know if the fish is fresh.

lines.speaker: learner
lines.text: Good. Give me half a kilo.

scenes.situation: You need to find the bus stop.

lines.speaker: learner
lines.text: Excuse me, where is the bus stop?

scenes.situation: You are lost in an unfamiliar neighbourhood.

lines.speaker: learner
lines.text: I am lost. Will you help me?

lines.speaker: other
lines.text: Of course. Where do you need to go?

scenes.situation: You want to know if it's walkable.

lines.speaker: other
lines.text: No, you can walk. Five minutes.

scenes.situation: You are negotiating with an auto-rickshaw driver.

lines.speaker: learner
lines.text: Will you go to Central Station?

lines.speaker: learner
lines.text: Will you come for seventy rupees?

scenes.situation: You need to choose between left and right.
You arrive at a restaurant and want a table.

lines.speaker: learner
lines.text: Two people. Can we get a table?

scenes.situation: The waiter comes to take your order.

lines.speaker: learner
lines.text: One masala dosa and one tea please.

lines.speaker: other
lines.text: OK, it will come right away.

scenes.situation: You have finished eating and want the bill.

lines.speaker: other
lines.text: Here is the bill. Two hundred rupees.

lines.speaker: learner
lines.text: Here is the money. Thank you.

scenes.situation: You want a recommendation from the waiter.

lines.speaker: learner
lines.text: Can you tell me what is good?

lines.speaker: other
lines.text: Today the sambar rice is very good.

scenes.situation: You want to make sure the food is not too spicy.

lines.speaker: other
lines.text: OK, we will make it mild.

scenes.situation: Someone spoke too quickly and you didn't catch it.

lines.speaker: other
lines.text: Fill in this form and bring your Aadhaar card.

lines.speaker: learner
lines.text: Sorry, I didn't understand. Can you say it slowly?

lines.speaker: other
lines.text: OK. You need your Aadhaar card.

scenes.situation: You missed what the announcer said at the station.

lines.speaker: other
lines.text: The train is leaving right now!

scenes.situation: You need to find someone who speaks English.

lines.speaker: other
lines.text: A little. What do you need?

lines.speaker: learner
lines.text: Thank you. I am looking for a hotel.

scenes.situation: You are looking for a hospital.

lines.speaker: learner
lines.text: Excuse me, where is the hospital?

lines.speaker: other
lines.text: Go straight, it's on the left.
